attempts.reasoning: Added cursor pagination mode detected by presence of `cursor` query param. Empty cursor means first page. Mutual exclusivity with `page` throws ApiError 400. Cursor decoding is wrapped to throw ApiError 400 'invalid cursor' on any malformed/tampered value, with additional validation that decoded object contains finite numeric createdAt and id. Ordering is newest first (createdAt desc, id desc) using comparison `createdAt < cursor.createdAt || (createdAt == cursor.createdAt && id < cursor.id)` to find start index, which avoids skip/dup when createdAt duplicates straddle pages and handles deleted items and new inserts. nextCursor is built with encodeCursor({createdAt, id}) of last item and is null when no further items, including exactly-full last page. Offset mode is preserved byte-for-byte. pageSize parsing is shared.
